text: راڑھ کچی، گاں گبھنی، مورکھ آس کرے۔
romanized: Rāṛh kachchī, gā̃ gabbhaṇī, mūrakh ās karé.
literal_en: He is a fool who expects anything from unripe crops or a cow in calf.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
